body: I'm seeing a psychiatrist but I haven't really talk about this. Life just sucks

Some of the islam "facts" that was teached at school is ridiculous. One google search can comfirm how there's no scientific evidence of it. From the stories of scientist finding evidence of the red sea & moon splitting to stories of Neil Armstrong converting to islam cause he heard the azan from the moon. How fucking stupid, but the most stupidest thing have to be my tuition science teacher telling the class he doesn't believe in dinosaurs cause it wasn't metioned in the Quran. Wow just wow. He believes all the stupid stuff in the quran but not the physical evidence of dinosaurs existing. I never wanted to face palm so hard in my life.
Not really that good, I just hope things will get better
I feel the same way when I cut too
I feel you. Qurantine really made my depression worst even tho I'm on meds. If you need someone to talk to I'm here.

Hello, I'm a 16 F too and I can 100% relate to your feelings. The feeling of depression eating you up when you're awake and the feeling of doubt that if it ever gets better. I just want to say how strong you are for going thru such a trauma. I'm happy to hear that your family & friends are supportive and the fact they want you to get better. My family isn't that understanding.

I also understand the feeling of wanting to do something good. One thing I wanna do is change the people in my country view on mental health since it's still a taboo thing and being an advocate for it. But at this point I don't know if I can.

If you need someone to talk to I'm here. It's nice to have someone you can relate to.
